_comment: #arch-m5 (#618): despite living under examples/, this IS the canonical config llmwiki ships — the base for every command. Your gitignored ./config.json is merged section-wise ON TOP of it (per-section keys override; omitted keys fall through to these defaults), so you only copy the sections you want to change. This merge applies to sync/convert too (#25).

filters._headless_comment: #8: skip headless `claude -p` / Agent-SDK sessions (entrypoint=sdk-* or promptSource=sdk). Prevents the synthesis feedback loop when the synthesizer shells out to `claude -p`.
filters._temp_cwd_comment: #8: skip sessions whose cwd is a throwaway temp dir (/tmp, /var/folders, ...). Default OFF — a git worktree under /tmp is often real work. Set true only if your temp dirs hold e2e/scratch junk.
filters._subagents_comment: #30: what to do with subagent transcripts (is_subagent: true — each Agent tool fan-out logs its own session; ~59% of a real corpus). 'all' = sync AND synthesize them like any session (full detail, maximum token spend). 'only-raw' = sync into raw/ (complete, greppable, re-synthesizable) but SKIP them in synthesize / queue-run backlog — the wiki covers their outcome via the parent session's synthesis. DEFAULT. 'off' = don't convert them at all; the only record is the ~500-char truncated excerpt of each subagent's final report inside the coordinator session (truncation.tool_result_chars). Switching only-raw->all makes existing raw subagents eligible for synthesis (they appear as backlog); switching to off only affects future syncs — it never deletes existing raw/ files.

redaction._comment: Set real_username to the part of your home path to replace. Auto-detected from $USER if empty.

_schedule_comment: Controls when wiki-build and wiki-lint run. Values: on-sync (after every sync), daily, weekly, manual, never.
_vault_comment: Default vault path for --vault flag. Set to your Obsidian/Logseq vault. Empty = must pass --vault explicitly.
_graph_comment: Default graph engine. builtin = stdlib wikilink graph (zero deps). graphify = AI-powered (requires pip install llmwiki[graph]).
_adapters_comment: Contrib adapters. All disabled by default — enable with: llmwiki sync --adapter <name>
_synthesis_comment: LLM backend for auto-synthesizing wiki source pages. backend=dummy (default, offline) | ollama (local HTTP) | claude (synchronous `claude -p` CLI; defaults to claude_model=sonnet, optional claude_path override). One backend serves every command (sync/synthesize/add). Run `llmwiki synthesize --check` to probe availability.

synthesis._pricing_comment: Optional pricing override (USD per 1M tokens) for `llmwiki synthesize --estimate` when provider prices/models change. If omitted, llmwiki uses the built-in local rate card and prints a warning that estimate may deviate.
